    def __init__(self, system, mesh):
        # Create a section, i.e. define thickness and material properties for the cable beam
        msection_cable2 = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
        msection_cable2.SetDiameter(0.015)  # Set the diameter of the cable section to 15 mm

            msection_cable2,  # The beam section properties to use
            10,  # Number of ANCF elements to create along the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.1),  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0.5, 0, -0.1)  # Ending point ('B' point) of the beam

        builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front().SetForce(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -0.7, 0))  # Apply forces to the front node

        constraint_hinge.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(), mtruss)
        system.Add(constraint_hinge)  # Add the constraint to the system

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import numpy as np

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#  Create the simulation system
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

my_system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set gravitational acceleration
my_system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Create the Irrlicht visualization system
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(my_system)
vis.SetWindowSize(800, 600)
vis.SetWindowTitle('ANCF Cable Beam Simulation')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(2, 2, 2))
vis.AddLight(chrono.ChVectorD(2, 2, 2), chrono.ChColor(1, 1, 1))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Create the ground body
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(10, 0.2, 10, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
my_system.Add(ground)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Create the ANCF cable beam
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

beam_length = 2
num_nodes = 10
beam_nodes = []

# Define beam material properties
rho = 1000  # Density
E = 1e7  # Young's modulus
A = 0.01  # Cross-sectional area

# Create beam nodes
for i in range(num_nodes):
    x = i * beam_length / (num_nodes - 1)
    node = chrono.ChNodeANCF(chrono.ChVectorD(x, 0, 0))
    beam_nodes.append(node)
    my_system.Add(node)

# Create ANCF cable elements
for i in range(num_nodes - 1):
    element = chrono.ChElementCableANCF()
    element.SetNodes(beam_nodes[i], beam_nodes[i + 1])
    element.SetMaterial(chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC(
        rho, E, A
    ))
    my_system.Add(element)

# Hinge the first node to the ground
constraint = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
constraint.Initialize(beam_nodes[0], ground)
my_system.Add(constraint)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Simulation loop
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    my_system.DoStepDynamics(0.01)

    # Visualize beam deformation and nodal positions (example)
    for node in beam_nodes:
        pos = node.GetPos()
        vis.DrawLine(pos, pos + chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.1, 0), chrono.ChColor(1, 0, 0))

    # Print node positions (optional)
    # for i, node in enumerate(beam_nodes):
    #     print(f"Node {i}: {node.GetPos()}")

        builder.BuildBeam(
            mesh,  # The mesh to which the created nodes and elements will be added
            msection_cable2,  # The beam section properties to use
            10,  # Number of ANCF elements to create along the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.1),  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0.5, 0, -0.1)  # Ending point ('B' point) of the beam
        )

        # Apply boundary conditions and loads:
        # Retrieve the end nodes of the beam and apply load/constraints
        builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front().SetForce(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -0.7, 0))  # Apply forces to the front node

        # Create a truss body (a fixed reference frame in the simulation)
        mtruss = chrono.ChBody()
        mtruss.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the truss body

        # Create and initialize a hinge constraint to fix beam's end point to the truss
        constraint_hinge = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
        constraint_hinge.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(), mtruss)
        system.Add(constraint_hinge)  # Add the constraint to the system

# Initialize the physical system and mesh container:
sys = chrono.ChSystemSMC()
mesh = fea.ChMesh()

# Create the model and add the mesh to the system

# Add visualization for the FEM mesh:

vis.AddTypicalLights()  # Add typical lights for better illumination
